title: Commodious
summary: COMMODIOUS, adjective Convenient; suitable; fit; proper; adapted to its use or purpose, or to wants and necessities; as a commodious house or room. The haven was not commodious to winter in. Acts 27:1

inlines.v: COMMODIOUS, adjective Convenient; suitable; fit; proper; adapted to its use or purpose, or to wants and necessities; as a commodious house or room. The haven was not commodious to winter in. Acts 27:12. It is followed by for before a noun; as a place commodious for a camp.
